evidence.excerpt: Evaluated on the WildCross benchmark, DAD improves average inter-sequence Recall@1 from 61.41% to 66.37% and Recall@5 from 65.86% to 72.49% over a matched appearance-only baseline, with the largest gains under reverse traversal and long-term appearance variation.
